unstuck_said.text: Operator rail-pitch filed on your official SDK (Evozim/x402-express#1): optional Nano (XNO) settlement leg beside USDC-on-Base. Framed in M2MCent terms (zero-fee sub-cent micro-calls, no relayer gas, plain nano_ payto address) with paypercall.dev as a live working reference. First Nano touch on M2MCent, all 1,004 MCP resources settle USDC today.

Second touch, the concrete door it opens: if M2MCent adds a Nano accept leg, the sub-cent micro-calls (the $0.001-class data/search/scrape nodes that are M2MCent/s whole inventory) become free to serve - callers settle for zero fee, no gas accounting, no relayer. The issue is framed as a settlement option, not a fork of the protocol.
